evidence_level: Authored independent integer projects, actual local Git and Python; no live provider/model/native-host acceptance.
groups: Saved workflow writes a two-line change, checks and commits its actual worker branch; lead target and task delivery stay unchanged.
Foreign files, preexisting staged files, wrong branch/head and missing owned database refuse before checking or committing.
Changed task/prose, original deadline, foreign attempt and omitted execution refuse commit admission.
Branch lineage cannot be reused by a different task.
Independent semantic check, enabled commit hook and whitespace failure leave HEAD unchanged and retain owned database.
Lost replies after actual commit and workflow receipt reconcile the same commit with one hook/check run.
Interruption after staging leaves an unresolved intent; resume never repeats staging/checks/commit blindly.
Two concurrent worker branches produce distinct commits and keep their own database and worktree.
Record Git stage, whitespace check, semantic checks and commit elapsed seconds separately, including the two-line change; no speed threshold or waived checks.
